definition: deadlock: strongly connected component (>= 2 robots) of the per-batch graph in which every STUCK robot has an edge to all adjacent faulted robots, else to all adjacent stuck robots, else (exactly one neighbour) to it; mutually blocked cluster that persists, not a proven circular wait. knot: maximal path of >= 2 edges among robots in no such component. length_s = end - start, start = latest stopped-run start among the members.
